findings.text: the instrument table cites /tmp/sgr_probe5.log, which does not exist on disk while the four sibling /tmp logs do, so the cited instrument for the component-token and completeness figures resolves nowhere; the durable copy is logs/sgr_probe5.log in the run directory.

the asserted second figure, 225 publishable of 253 defect-bearing names, is compared against 2,528 accepted live names, the whole live cohort, so that column does not re-measure the asserted quantity and a reader cannot see how many of the re-measured 304 operator-bearing names are publishable.

the row substitutes a schema surface, 486 names carrying a component token with 265 live over 16 tokens, for the asserted stem partition of 505 component-prefixed stems bearing 345 single-component and 176 true vector components, so the 176 figure that the plan sizes completion work from carries no verdict.
